I am an old woman of 58, and this small plot near my home I keep for beans mixed with other crops. Beans do not need the fertilizer like maize does — they make their own goodness in the soil. I have no coupon for fertilizer this year, and what little I might get I would put on my maize plot, not here. I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, weed by hand with my family, and pray for good rains.
